en: Black‑and‑white wartime postcard showing French (and Allied) soldiers disembarking from a ship onto a cobbled quay. The scene is a busy military landing with officers and men carrying bags and equipment beside a harbor with masts, cranes, and warehouses in the background. Printed captions in French and English at the bottom identify the view as a World War I scene in the Balkans at Salonica (Thessaloniki).
